raw.details:
VYTRON 2026 – National Online Hackathon

Website : https://vytron26.droidecks.sbs/

Registration Link : https://forms.gle/9r5Qj42Np9nZ6yhc7

Registration Fee: 79 per member

 Engineer the Extraordinary.

About Organizer

Droidecks is an Indian cybersecurity and technology services company based in Chennai, founded in 2019.
    • Core Focus. They help businesses protect their digital systems through security testing (VAPT), cloud audits, and compliance consulting (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  • Tech & Automation. They build custom, secure software and set up automated security workflows.
  • Community Events. They are also known across India for organizing national-level student coding competitions and hackathons.
 

About the Hackathon

VYTRON 2026 is a national-level online hackathon that brings together passionate students, developers, and innovators from colleges across India to transform creative ideas into impactful real-world solutions.

Participants can explore all technology domains, including Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Web Development, Cybersecurity, Blockchain, Internet of Things, Cloud Computing, Robotics, and more.

Get ready to showcase your technical skills, creativity, problem-solving abilities, and innovation through three exciting rounds.

Competition Structure

Round 1: Idea Presentation (PPT Submission)
Submit a presentation highlighting your problem statement, proposed solution, objectives, innovation, and expected impact. Shortlisted teams will advance to the next round.

Round 2: Abstract & Project Submission
Submit your project abstract along with the implementation, technical details, project files, or GitHub repository. Projects will be evaluated based on functionality, technical execution, and innovation.

Round 3: Final Jury Evaluation
Shortlisted teams will present and demonstrate their projects before the jury through an online presentation, followed by a Q&A session.

Participation Guidelines

  • Team Size: 2–4 members

  • Participation: Intra-college and inter-college teams are welcome

  • Mode: Fully Online

  • Eligibility: College students across India

  • Domains: Open to all technology domains

Important Dates

  • Registration Deadline: 25 November 2026

  • Hackathon Dates: Tentatively after 15 December 2026

  • Further round-wise deadlines and instructions will be communicated to registered participants.

Why Participate?

  • Showcase your ideas and technical expertise on a national platform.

  • Collaborate with talented innovators from different colleges.

  • Gain experience in real-world problem-solving and project development.

  • Present your work before an expert jury.

  • Turn your ideas into meaningful technological solutions.

Ready to Engineer the Extraordinary?

Bring your ideas, build innovative solutions, and make your mark at VYTRON 2026.

Register now and be part of the innovation!

prizes.others: Will be rewarded to 5 teams each 1k
